heading.zh-Hant: 列兵入伍到參謀學院校長
heading.en: From trooper to Commandant of the Staff College

body.zh-Hant: 羅伯遜1860年1月29日生於林肯郡韋爾本，父親是村裡的郵務員兼裁縫。他1877年11月13日入伍，先在第16槍騎兵團服役，1888年底轉任第3龍騎兵衛隊的軍官。1900年1月20日，他抵達開普敦，在波耳戰爭中負責蒐集與研究情報。1910年6月，帝國總參謀長來信邀他回參謀學院擔任校長；1913年10月離開時已是少將，並獲授維多利亞皇家勳章爵級司令，隨後調回陸軍部出任軍事訓練處長。
body.en: Robertson was born on 29 January 1860 in Welbourn, a Lincolnshire village, where his father was postmaster and tailor. He joined the Army on 13 November 1877, first in the 16th Lancers, and at the end of 1888 arrived in his next regiment, the 3rd Dragoon Guards, as an officer. He reached Cape Town on 20 January 1900 and was given the duty of collecting and studying intelligence in the South African War. In June 1910 the CIGS invited him back to the Staff College as Commandant; when he left in October 1913 he was a Major-General and a Knight Commander of the Victorian Order, and was summoned back to the War Office as Director of Military Training.

heading.en: Rise from the ranks and the Staff College

body.zh-Hant: 羅伯遜是英國陸軍史上唯一從列兵入伍、最後官至元帥的人。他因通曉五種語言，被選入印度西姆拉陸軍總部的情報處，那是他初次接觸參謀工作。他在奇特拉爾遠征中獲頒傑出服務勳章，當時這是一種相當罕見的勳章。1897年1月至1898年12月，他就讀於坎伯利參謀學院。
body.en: Robertson was the only man in the army's history to enlist as a private soldier and end as a field marshal. Selected, thanks to his five languages, for the Intelligence Branch at Army Headquarters in Simla, he got his first introduction to staff work there. For the relief of Chitral he received the Distinguished Service Order, then a rather rare decoration. He attended the Staff College from January 1897 to December 1898.

heading.zh-Hant: 遠征軍軍需總監與蒙斯撤退
heading.en: Quartermaster-General of the BEF and the retreat from Mons

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月，羅伯遜隨英國遠征軍赴法，在總司令約翰·弗倫奇元帥的參謀部出任軍需總監。蒙斯戰役後的撤退歷時十三天；撤退開始前，他已決定把遠征軍的前進基地由亞眠南遷勒芒。1915年1月25日，他卸下「軍需總監」職務，改任遠征軍的參謀長（總參謀長）。
body.en: In August 1914 Robertson crossed to France on the staff of the Commander-in-Chief, Field-Marshal Sir John French, as Quartermaster-General. The retreat from Mons lasted thirteen days; before it had even begun he had decided to shift the BEF's advanced base from Amiens to Le Mans. On 25 January 1915 he ceased to be the BEF's storekeeper-in-chief and became Chief of its General Staff.

heading.zh-Hant: 1915年的遠征軍參謀長與出任帝國總參謀長
heading.en: Chief of the BEF General Staff in 1915 and the call to the War Office

body.zh-Hant: 泰拉恩稱1915年是英軍最悲慘的一年，癥結在於物資不足。自蒙斯撤退以來，政府部分圈子就對弗倫奇存疑，6月羅伯遜曾對漢基說弗倫奇「總想做魯莽而不可能的事」。12月4日他與基奇納首次面談；隨後他登上事業高峰，出任帝國總參謀長。
body.en: Terraine calls 1915 a miserable year for the British Army, its sorrows summed up in the word shortages. There had been grave doubts about French in some government circles since the retreat from Mons, and in June Robertson told Hankey that French was always wanting to do reckless and impossible things. He held his first interview with Kitchener on 4 December, and then came to the high peak of his career as CIGS.

citations.quote: The year 1915 was a miserable one for the British Army.
Its sorrows may be summed up in one dismal word: shortages.
had been grave doubts about him in some Government circles
in June Wully had told Lieutenant Colonel Hankey

went to his first interview with this famous but imperious soldier on 4 December
So Wully Robertson now came to the high peak of his career - CIGS.

heading.en: Chief of the Imperial General Staff and removal

body.zh-Hant: 1916年12月勞合·喬治出任首相，面對他的種種權宜辦法，羅伯遜是出面反對的人；1918年2月，雙方就最高軍事會議（凡爾賽）的權限公開衝突。他不接受這種他認為危險的制度，不肯改任，1918年2月16日他卸任帝國總參謀長，由威爾遜將軍接替。
body.en: In December 1916 Lloyd George became Prime Minister, and it was Robertson who had to oppose his expedients. In February 1918 the conflict over the Supreme War Council at Versailles came into the open. Refusing to accept as CIGS a system he had condemned as dangerous, he lost the fight, and on 16 February 1918 he ceased to be CIGS and was replaced by General Wilson.

heading.zh-Hant: 本土部隊、萊茵軍團與晉升元帥
heading.en: Home Forces, Army of the Rhine and the field marshal's baton

body.zh-Hant: 1918年6月5日，羅伯遜出任本土部隊總司令；1919年3月13日接替普盧默，改任萊茵軍團總司令。1920年3月29日，他經邱吉爾推薦獲晉升元帥，那是他軍旅生涯的終點。倫敦憲報載，萊茵軍團總司令一職自1920年3月3日起改由莫蘭中將接替羅伯遜。
body.en: On 5 June 1918 Robertson became commander-in-chief of all Home Forces. On 13 March 1919 he became commander-in-chief of the Army of the Rhine, following General Plumer. On 29 March 1920, on Churchill's recommendation, he was promoted field marshal, which ended his soldiering. The London Gazette notice of 12 March 1920 shows Lieutenant-General Sir T. L. N. Morland appointed to the Army of the Rhine command in Robertson's place from 3 March 1920.

heading.en: Commander of the British army in France, 1914–15

body.zh-Hant: 弗倫奇原是騎兵將領，曾在第二次波耳戰爭中率領騎兵師，並任帝國總參謀長，1914至15年成為英國駐法軍隊的首任司令。牛津辭典評他並不適任：他是富有魅力的騎兵，卻不懂參謀作業與外交，與法國盟友關係冷淡，面對戰壕僵局只會要求更多砲彈。
body.en: French had led a cavalry division in the second Boer War and served as chief of the imperial general staff before becoming the first commander of the British army in France in 1914–15. The Oxford Companion judges him ill suited to the role: a charismatic cavalryman with little understanding of staff work or diplomacy, whose relations with his French allies were frosty and whose only answer to trench stalemate was ever more shells.

heading.en: The shell scandal of May 1915

body.zh-Hant: 到1915年5月，要求更多砲彈的辦法已經失效，弗倫奇便私下鼓動《泰晤士報》與《每日郵報》，指責基奇納供應砲彈不足，意圖找替罪羊。他本人在這場風波中勉強過關。
body.en: By May 1915 the recipe of more shells no longer worked, and French sought a scapegoat by secretly encouraging The Times and the Daily Mail to blame Kitchener for failing to provide enough shells. He himself barely survived the ensuing scandal.

heading.en: The Battle of Loos and dismissal

body.zh-Hant: 1915年9月至10月的盧斯戰役再度失敗，弗倫奇於12月被免去總司令職務。英國國家陸軍博物館稱，這次戰役的失敗迫使他辭去遠征軍司令，由道格拉斯·黑格將軍接替。
body.en: A further failure at Loos in September–October 1915 preceded his dismissal in December 1915. The National Army Museum says the failures of the battle forced French to resign as commander of the British Expeditionary Force, and that General Sir Douglas Haig replaced him.

heading.en: 1941: Greece and Palestine

body.zh-Hant: 英國官方戰史附錄把威爾遜列為駐希臘英軍（W Force）的指揮官；並載明他自1941年5月7日起，出任巴勒斯坦與外約旦英軍的司令官。
body.en: The official history's appendix lists Lieutenant-General Sir Henry Maitland Wilson as commander of British troops in Greece (W Force), and records him in command of Palestine and Transjordan from 7 May 1941.

heading.en: Persia and Iraq Command

body.zh-Hant: 1942年8月21日，威爾遜就任波斯與伊拉克司令部總司令，司令部於9月15日在巴格達開設。他的首要任務是不惜一切守住波斯與伊拉克的油田與石油設施；其次是保障由波斯灣港口運往蘇聯的補給。1943年2月17日，他離開前往開羅就任新職。
body.en: Wilson took up his appointment as Commander-in-Chief, Persia and Iraq Command on 21 August 1942, with General Headquarters opening in Baghdad on 15 September. His first task was to secure the oil fields and installations in Persia and Iraq at all costs; the second was to ensure the transport of supplies to Russia from the Persian Gulf ports. On 17 February 1943 he left for Cairo to take up new duties.

heading.en: Supreme Allied Commander, Mediterranean

body.zh-Hant: 1944年1月8日，艾森豪威爾預定把地中海戰區的責任移交給威爾遜，由他出任地中海戰區盟軍最高司令，美軍的德弗斯中將是他的副手。1944年12月12日，亞歷山大元帥接替他出任地中海最高司令；威爾遜晉升元帥，改任英國參謀長委員會駐華盛頓的高級代表。
body.en: On 8 January 1944 Eisenhower was to pass his responsibilities to Wilson, who would become Supreme Allied Commander of the Mediterranean theater, with Lieutenant General Devers as his deputy. On 12 December 1944 Field Marshal Alexander replaced him as Supreme Commander in the Mediterranean area; Wilson was promoted to Field Marshal and became senior representative in Washington of the British Chiefs of Staff.

people.name: Arthur Tedder, 1st Baron Tedder
people.nameZh: 第一代泰德男爵亞瑟·泰德

heading.en: Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, RAF Middle East

body.zh-Hant: 泰德在劍橋讀歷史，一戰時加入皇家飛行團。1941年6月1日起，他接替朗莫爾出任皇家空軍中東司令部的空軍總司令；牛津辭典則把他的中東任期記為1941年5月至1943年2月。美國官方戰史稱，他1942年在中東指揮空軍，協助阻止隆美爾推進埃及，也對蒙哥馬利的阿拉曼進攻之成功有重大貢獻。
body.en: Tedder read history at Cambridge and joined the RFC in the First World War. From 1 June 1941 he succeeded Longmore as Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of RAF Middle East, though the Oxford Companion dates his Middle East command May 1941 to February 1943. The US official history says he was British air commander in the Middle East in 1942, helping to stop Rommel's advance toward Egypt and contributing significantly to the success of Montgomery's El Alamein attack.

body.en: From 17 February 1943 Tedder served as Commander in Chief, Mediterranean Allied Air Forces, which included RAF Middle East, RAF Malta Air Command and the Northwest African Air Forces, until the end of the year. Many U.S. and British airmen came to hold him in high esteem.

heading.en: Deputy Supreme Commander, SHAEF

body.zh-Hant: 1944年1月，泰德獲選為盟軍最高司令部（SHAEF）副最高司令。美國官方戰史稱他是橫渡海峽作戰中盟軍空中力量的總協調人。牛津辭典則稱他負責統籌「霸王行動」入侵中所有盟軍飛機，後來成為皇家空軍元帥。
body.en: In January 1944 Tedder was chosen as Deputy Supreme Commander of SHAEF. The US official history calls him the chief co-ordinator of Allied air efforts in support of the cross-Channel operation. The Oxford Companion says he secured co-ordination of all allied aircraft in the invasion, and that he became marshal of the RAF.

people.name: Andrew Cunningham, 1st Viscount Cunningham of Hyndhope
people.nameZh: 第一代海德霍普的康寧漢子爵安德魯·康寧漢

heading.zh-Hant: 從見習生到一戰驅逐艦艦長
heading.en: From cadet to destroyer captain in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 坎寧安於1897年以見習生身分進入海軍（美國官方戰史則作1898年）。一戰期間他大多擔任驅逐艦「天蠍座號」艦長，並在1915年達達尼爾登陸作戰中表現突出；1918年他轉入多佛巡邏隊；1919年他參加波羅的海對布爾什維克的作戰。
body.en: Cunningham entered the navy as a cadet in 1897 (the US official history gives 1898). He spent most of the First World War as captain of the destroyer Scorpion and distinguished himself at the Dardanelles landings in 1915. In 1918 he joined the Dover patrol, and in 1919 he took part in the Baltic operations against the Bolsheviks.

entered the Royal Navy in 1898
captain of the destroyer
distinguished himself at the landings on the Dardanelles in 1915
In 1918 he joined the Dover patrol

heading.zh-Hant: 地中海艦隊：塔蘭托與馬塔潘角
heading.en: Mediterranean Fleet: Taranto and Cape Matapan

body.zh-Hant: 二戰爆發時，坎寧安已是代理上將、地中海艦隊總司令。美國官方戰史說他在1939至1942年間指揮對義大利艦隊的作戰，包括塔蘭托與馬塔潘，並從希臘撤出英軍。1940年11月，空襲塔蘭托港迫使義大利艦隊北撤；1941年3月，他在夜戰中於馬塔潘角大敗義大利艦隊，旗艦為「厭戰號」。
body.en: When the Second World War began Cunningham was an acting admiral and commander-in-chief Mediterranean. The US official history says that between 1939 and 1942 he directed operations against the Italian fleet at Taranto and Matapan and evacuated British forces from Greece. In November 1940 an air attack on Taranto harbour forced the Italian fleet to withdraw northwards, and in March 1941 he won a decisive night victory off Cape Matapan, his flag in the Warspite.

heading.zh-Hant: 華盛頓、北非登陸與西西里
heading.en: Washington, the North African landings and Sicily

body.zh-Hant: 1942年，坎寧安短暫出任英國海軍部駐華盛頓代表團團長，美國人對他十分欣賞，因此提議由他擔任入侵北非遠征軍的盟軍海軍司令，登陸在1942年11月。1943年他在西西里與義大利作戰，並晉升海軍元帥。
body.en: In 1942 Cunningham briefly headed the British Admiralty Delegation in Washington and so endeared himself to the Americans that they proposed him as Allied Naval Commander of the Expeditionary Force to invade North Africa in November 1942. He was subsequently in Sicily and Italy in 1943 with the rank of Admiral of the Fleet.

heading.en: First Sea Lord, 1943–46

body.zh-Hant: 1943年10月，坎寧安奉召接替病重的龐德，出任第一海務大臣兼海軍參謀長，直到1946年6月退役。任內他主持諾曼第登陸、地中海作戰與擊沉「沙恩霍斯特號」及「提爾皮茨號」等行動。1945年他受封男爵，次年晉升子爵。
body.en: In October 1943 Cunningham was summoned to replace the dying Pound as First Sea Lord and Chief of the Naval Staff, a position he held until his retirement in June 1946. In that time he presided over the invasion of Normandy, operations in the Mediterranean and the sinking of the Scharnhorst and Tirpitz. In 1945 he was given a barony and advanced to viscount the following year.
